headlines.title: McDonald's (MCD) Must Keep Fighting McRib Marketing Class Action Suit
headlines.summary: McDonald's (NYSE:MCD) failed to secure dismissal of a proposed class-action lawsuit over McRib marketing in a recent federal court ruling. Plaintiffs claim McDonald's advertising led customers to believe the McRib contained rib meat rather than other processed pork parts. The judge's order keeps alive allegations that McDonald's misrepresented the nature and quality of pork used in the McRib sandwich.

headlines.title: McDonald's Stock Ahead of Q3 Earnings: Buy, Sell or Wait for Now?
headlines.summary: MCD faces mixed Q3 prospects as beverage expansion and international growth support sales, while weak U.S. traffic, rising costs and operational challenges raise concerns about earnings.

headlines.title: JPMorgan's shocking capital expenditures estimates for Amazon, and worries for McDonald's ahead
headlines.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi breaks down all the top headlines of the trading day, including how hyperscalers have gotten "silly cheap," Nvidia's (NVDA) "unbelievable" valuation, and why McDonald's (MCD) earnings should have investors worried. Sozzi also sits down with the Founder & CEO of JC2 Ventures and Former Cisco Executive Chairman & CEO John Chambers to discuss the current state of the tech market.

description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
